title: Uniform frustrated-cycle stability below a star threshold
scope: For every integer k>=3 and t>=0, there is one N(k,t)>=t+2 such that every n>=N and every finite simple undirected graph G on n vertices with f_k(G)<f_k(the(t+1)-edge star plus isolated vertices on n vertices) has G or its WHOLE complement within at most t unordered-pair edge flips of a complete bipartite graph, allowing empty cut parts. Here f_k counts ambient injective k-vertex cyclic orderings modulo rotations and reversal with an odd number of present G-edges; it does not count only graph-contained cycles. Includes genuine quotient/counting, exact threshold, common N, k3/t0, complement and unordered edit bridges. False separate odd-n/even-k remark excluded.
source_targets: Kittipassorn/Meszaros, Frustrated Triangles, owned arXiv1411.1749v2(8April2015),Conjecture19 printedp18; exact proof-empty retrieved MathDB329202 record. Internal February date is not arXiv revision date. False odd-n/even-k aside excluded.
